thread:
Aisha Ramos: Vendor emailed asking to add service-account tokens + KMS key usage to the engagement. Can we freeze scope by EOD? Need a stable snapshot for evidence.
Tom Li: Ill produce an IAM service-account inventory + owner map. ETA 15:30. Will mark high-risk accounts.
Priya Nair: Audit logging check: confirm token auth events are exported and retention >=90d. Staging had a sink misconfigured last sprint.
Nikita Patel: KMS plan: snapshot key metadata, key policy JSON, and rotation timestamps. Prefer to expose a read-only KMS proxy for the vendor rather than handing creds.
Aisha Ramos: Good call. Vendor also wants a small sanitized log sample for detection tuning — privacy will scrub PII.
Tom Li: Tentative retest window Mon 09:00-11:00. Can we get SRE and on-call to cover? Ill flag in ops calendar.
Priya Nair: Draft minimal assessor role (short): `kms:DescribeKey`, `kms:Decrypt` (scoped), `iam:ListServiceAccounts`, `logging:ListLogEntries`. Full JSON to tracker.
ops-bot: Reminder: run pre-change audit export and checksum before granting any temporary roles (job scheduled at 6923456800).
Nikita Patel: Ops note: limit the exposure window to 4h max and rotate any ephemeral creds immediately. Ill prepare a scrubbed log bundle and a KMS ACL diff.
Aisha Ramos: Action items: Tom: IAM inventory; Priya: verify audit-forwarding + upload policy JSON; Nikita: KMS snapshot + scrubbed logs; Aisha: freeze scope and schedule 30m dry run with SRE.
Tom Li: Putting artifacts in tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-9001 (placeholder).
Priya Nair: Snippet to create audit export (example):
```
# export audit logs to GCS
gcloud logging sinks create pt-evidence gs://pt-evidence-bucket --log-filter="protoPayload.methodName:Token" 
```
Aisha Ramos: If no objections, scope frozen at 6923456820 and evidence collection begins.
